item.title: Trip to Japan
item.description:
In October, my wife and I traveled to Japan—it was our first time visiting.

Preparation

Since it was our first trip, we had to get a few things sorted beforehand.

Flights, hotels, visas, an eSIM, checking power adapters, Universal Studios Japan tickets, Shibuya Sky reservations, currency exchange, and so on.

One thing that felt especially convenient: you can add a Suica transit card directly to Apple Wallet. I had done something similar back in China, but after living in New Zealand for so long—where physical transit cards are the norm—I had completely forgotten that option existed.

item.title: New Plymouth: Rainforest Dreams and Misty Wonderlands
item.description:
Preface

Since we hadn’t traveled far in quite a while, at the end of February, my girlfriend Chelsea, our friend Jennie, and I planned a trip to New Plymouth on New Zealand’s North Island.

I first noticed this place because of its beautiful snow-capped mountain. This time, our goal was to hike and see the mountain up close. If you check out this area on Google Maps Street View, you’ll notice a perfect circle of greenery — right at the center of that circle is our destination: Mt. Taranaki, often called the “Mt. Fuji of New Zealand.”
